pubbavideha.cp: masc. name of the eastern continent.
pubbavideha.p: [ pubba + videha ] (pu) Google Translate Pubbavideha Island East Island.
pn: Pubbavideha. The eastern of the four continents (mahādīpā) which compose a Cakkavāḷa (AN.i.227; v.59). It is seven thousand leagues in extent (Snp-a. 443; 8,000 says Bv-a.112) and its chief tree is the Acacia (Sirīsa) (AN-a.i.264; MN-a.ii.947; Vsm.i.206, etc.). It is the first mahādīpa visited by a Cakkavatti when on tour (Bv-a.131). See also s.v. Videha.
